text: The Architectural Association of Kenya congratulates Plan. Mugendi G. Moses, M.A.A.K (TP) on his appointment as Non-Executive Chairperson of the Physical Planners Registration Board for a three-year term. We wish him great success as he takes on this important role in regulating and advancing physical planning in Kenya.

text: The Architectural Association of Kenya wishes all Kenyan citizens a happy Mashujaa Day! May we continue to honour the heroes who shaped our nation and build on their legacy. #mashujaaday

images.alt: AAK wishes you a happy Mashujaa Day: we salute the heroes of our past who paved the way for our freedom and independence, beside a sculpture of figures raising the Kenyan flag

text: The Architectural Association of Kenya invites applications for the UIA Working Bodies 2026-2029 Term. This call is open to already engaged members and new interested members for UIA Commissions and Boards. Open to AAK Architects Chapter members in good standing. All - including young architects (up to 40 years old), are encouraged to apply. Deadline: Thursday, 22nd October 2026, 5:00 PM EAT Apply to: architects@aak.or.ke cc: aak@aak.or.ke Scan the QR code on the poster for full details on Commissions, Boards and Work Programmes or use this link

text: Every year, the world marks World Cities Day, a global moment to reflect on sustainable urban growth. In line with this, @NationMediaGrp (NMG), in partnership with AAK will host the forum on 29th and 30th October at the Iconic Plaza Hotel, Nairobi, under the theme “From Urban Challenges to Smart, Sustainable and Inclusive Futures" Participants will enjoy a dynamic blend of exhibitions, thought-leadership sessions, masterclasses, and networking opportunities. Reserve your slot today as a 1. Delegate: Join industry leaders, access all masterclasses and sessions, and network with peers shaping tomorrow’s cities 2. Exhibitor / Booth Partner: Showcase your innovations and position your brand at the heart of Africa’s smart city transformation. Contact us: Jason on +254 719 852 358 / jjmutua@ke.nationmedia.com AAK on +254 721 691 337 / aak@aak.or.ke
